x: Not to be outdone in suspenders and Black stockings(Yes I know this is a family mag. but you should have been there) was 'St. Trinian' - Maureen. The morning was concluded at Belgrave Hall with a hot punch bowl providing a fitting end to a really amusing event.
It's good to see Maureen and Brian Pritchard attending our functions. Recently Master Thomas Pritchard (born 11/05/1999) was signed up, making him a fourth generation Belgravian.

Many thanks to Will for getting it off the ground - to Pat for rustling up a score or more helpings of home-made lasagne and chilli con carne, to Maureen and Brian for providing the baked potatoes and to Cynthia for helping in the kitchen.
